programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 24 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. programme.title: TEBARAN HATI EPS 74 [P13]
programme.desc: This story begins with Ariana, a renowned reporter and the adopted daughter of the respected Prawira family. She is willing to sacrifice everything to protect the good name of the family that raised her. When Ladya, her adopted younger sister, becomes depressed after getting pregnant out of wedlock and being abandoned by her boyfriend who flees abroad, to the point of attempting suicide, Ariana is asked by her adoptive mother, Indar, to claim the baby as her own. This decision shatters Ariana’s career and calls off her wedding to Kai, her boyfriend from a wealthy family.

programme.title: CINTA TANPA KARENA EPS 454 [P13]
programme.desc: Couple of lovers who are prevented from being together by their parents' approval. They are Dipta (Megantara) and Nuna (Ochi Rosdiana), and they must maintain their love in secret. Due to Nuna's mother's blockade, their love tale must overcome numerous challenges

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 76 [P13]
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husband—Lala enters the third season of the Champion of Chef cooking competition, and her victory brings her closer to Julian, one of the judges in the competition.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 109 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 52 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: 99 NAMA CINTA 34 [P13]
programme.desc: Talia lives under the spotlight of cameras and the heat of celebrity news. Since her fiancé passed away, she has kept her heart tightly closed. To her, love only brings loss. Meanwhile, Kiblat is a respected young ustad—calm, courteous, and firm in his principles. His life is well-directed—until an incident brings him face-to-face with Talia in a heated argument over a minor accident. They instantly dislike each other. Unbeknownst to them, their parents have long been bound by a promise: to arrange their children’s marriage. When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 54 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 26 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha’s lives?

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOceans' scientists on an expedition to uncover more of their secrets and behaviours.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: In A 'Tale Of Two Sharks' we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bays are magnets for rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it’s the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the foundation for an intricate marine food chain

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.

programme.desc: Far from just another interview show - this is conversation shaped by experience. Because foreign policy is not just theory. It must be lived. Hosted by India’s former External Affairs Minister and one of the country’s most respected legal minds, Salman Khurshid, the show offers a rare window into how the world is understood by those who have helped shape it. The seasoned statesman draws on decades of diplomacy, law, and international negotiations as host. Don't miss the conversation.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Mu Sheng mula curiga dengan Miao Miao, Mujur Miao Miao telah membaca novel itu dan sudah bersedia. Dia menggunakan kaedah baharu untuk mengubah kualiti rambutnya dan melarikan diri daripada syak wasangka Mu Sheng.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 3 )
programme.desc: Episod ini hos bersama Soo Wincci, Baki, Berg Lee, dan Chen Siyu berkumpul di Chopsticks Talent School untuk menyertai siri permainan. Episod ini turut memaparkan bakat luar biasa murid sekolah tersebut dalam acara nyanyian dan tarian.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Chee Kan mengaku kepada Jia Mei bahawa dia masih mencintainya. Bagaimanakah respon Jia Mei? Suatu hari, Jia Mei menerima panggilan daripada Jia Ming yang mengancam untuk membakar gudang fabrik "Smile Light".

programme.title: NO ROOM FOR CRIME
programme.desc: Lok Yee mengeluarkan semua wang simpanan dari bank, untuk melarikan diri ke Korea Selatan kerana takut diganggu oleh Fan Kei. Jim yang terpikat dengan Lok Yee, menyerang Fan Kei sebagai amaran agar berhenti mengganggu Lok Yee.

programme.title: IN SPITE OF THE STRONG WIND
programme.desc: Tang Chen datang ke pejabat Kan Li untuk mengutip hutang. Kan Li enggan membayar tetapi Tang Chen secara rahsia merakam perbualan mereka. Shuo Bing meminta Ye Shouru melantik Yising sebagai agensi PR untuk Kumpulan Nan Sing.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ling Feng bimbang rahsia Zhi Sheng terbongkar ketika bertemu Zi Qian di tokong. Sementara itu, Ivan menghasut Zai Xing agar tidak memaafkan Yun Jin, walaupun keluarga merayu agar jawatan Yun Jin dikembalikan semula.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Li Ping bertemu Guo Qing di hospital dan melawat nenek yang koma. Keajaiban berlaku apabila nenek terjaga selepas diseru Li Ping. Sementara itu, Daisy semakin pulih, manakala Kai Hong mula merasa cemburu terhadap layanan Zi Sheng.

programme.title: HEAVENLY HAND
programme.desc: Zhang Tie bersetuju menguruskan empayar mahjong Ouyang Zong meski diragui kakitangan. Cabaran mahjong diatur bagi membuktikan kepimpinannya. Sementara itu, suasana hiba menyelubungi Situ apabila Jiaming akhirnya mengakuinya sebagai bapa.

programme.title: 18 AGAIN
programme.desc: Da Jung dan Si Ah mencapai persefahaman setelah bergaduh. Si Ah menyedari kasih sayang ibunya itu terhadapnya. Manakala Da Jung juga bersetuju tidak akan menghalang hasrat Si Ah untuk menjadi seorang jurusolek profesional.

programme.title: THE IRON LADY
programme.desc: Permohonan pinjaman syarikat Qian Hi telah ditolak oleh bank. Shi Qin berasa amat gelisah dan tertekan kerana khuatir syarikat Qian Hi akan jatuh ke dalam tangan rakan kongsinya, Vincent.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Pengarang kegemaran Ling Miao Miao akhirnya mengeluarkan novel baharu. Namun, karya baharu "Catching Demons" ini hanyalah sebuah kisah cinta yang tidak bermakna. Miao Miao sangat marah sehingga dia menghantar ulasan yang buruk.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Sistem tempoh perlindungan pemula telah tamat. Jika Miao Miao mati, ia akan menjadi kenyataan. Pada masa yang sama, Miao Miao menerima tugasan sulit. Untuk kembali ke dunia nyata, dia perlu membuat Mu Sheng jatuh cinta padanya.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 3 )
programme.desc: Episod ini hos bersama 4 orang pengacara TV wanita memakai pakaian tradisional Korea dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan, masing-masing diketuai oleh Rickman dan Ken untuk menyertai siri permainan di Plaza Korea, Kuala Lumpur.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Tragedi kebakaran di gudang "Smile Light" telah menyebabkan ramai mangsa cedera dan dimasukkan ke hospital. Jia Mei dan Chee Kan tidak terkecuali menerima nasib malang.

programme.title: NO ROOM FOR CRIME
programme.desc: Siasatan oleh polis menunjukkan bahawa Fan Kei mati akibat kecederaan di bahagian dada setelah ditikam. Jim yang dilihat menyerang Fan Kei sebelum dia mati melalui CCTV jalanan, kini menjadi suspek utama dan diburu polis.

programme.title: IN SPITE OF THE STRONG WIND
programme.desc: Shuo Bing tiba tepat pada masanya menyelamatkan Bai Ying daripada teman lelakinya yang cuba merogolnya. Shuo Bing sempat merakamkan perlakuan lelaki itu. Kan Li terkejut menerima saman berkaitan hutangnya kepada Huijin.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Yun Jin dilanggar oleh sebuah kereta apabila melindungi Ya Jie. Yun Jin dikejarkan ke hospital dalam keadaan tenat. Ya Jie mendermakan darah untuk Yun Jin yang mengalami pendarahan teruk dan memerlukan pembedahan segera.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Guo Qing dan Zi Sheng diserang oleh kumpulan penunjuk perasaan. Guo Qing dibaling batu, tercedera dan berdarah di kepala. Mujurnya muncul Liao Qian Kun dan Mei Hua yang dapat menenangkan kumpulan penunjuk perasaan.

programme.title: HEAVENLY HAND
programme.desc: Pembunuh psikopat Yang Jian memerangkap Situ Jiu dengan dadah sehingga ditahan polis. Konflik memuncak apabila Yang Jian menculik Zhang Tie dan menuntut pengorbanan ngeri daripada Situ sebagai syarat untuk membebaskan rakannya itu.

programme.title: 18 AGAIN
programme.desc: Da Jung melarang Si Woo rapat dengan Woo Young. Dia menghalau Woo Young di hadapan anaknya itu. Si Woo memberitahu Da Jung bahawa Woo Young sentiasa melindunginya ketika dia dibuli di sekolah dan menasihatinya untuk kekal positif.

programme.title: THE IRON LADY
programme.desc: Shi Qin rasa amat terkejut dan gelisah apabila mendapati Lin Ci telah memiliki syer di dalam syarikat Qian Hi. Susulan itu, dia dilantik menyandang jawatan tinggi dalam syarikat tersebut.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Miao Miao mengambil kesempatan daripada Mu Yao dan menyusahkan Mu Sheng. Apabila Miao Miao berasa baik, dia menerima tugas baharu untuk memusnahkan pusaka "Peta Gunung dan Laut Ratus Setan" yang disimpan oleh Mu Yao.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Miao Miao membawa Lin Lu Shan ke pasar dan memasak. Lin Lu Shan terkejut apabila anak perempuannya belajar banyak perkara. Miao Miao membuka hatinya kepada Lin Lu Shan, dan bercakap tentang apa yang dialami dalam "mimpinya".

programme.title: MYSTIQUE VALLEY
programme.desc: Tie Ming yang dicampakkan ke dalam sungai, telah diselamatkan oleh seorang rakan sekerja. Dalam pada itu, kawasan pembalakan sekali lagi diganggu kejadian mistik, menyebabkan para pekerja enggan kembali bekerja.

programme.title: BOLEH SAYA BANTU?
programme.desc: URAT DAWAI. Kehadiran seorang tukang urut bernama Tok Ram yang menjalankan servis mengurut telah mengganggu ketenteraman pelanggan yang lain dengan bau minyak angin dan jeritan pesakit yang diurutnya.

programme.title: KERANA CINTA ITU DUSTA
programme.desc: Orked ke rumah Sufian berjumpa anak-anaknya tetapi dihalang malah diusir oleh Sufian. Sufian merancang supaya anak-anaknya keluar bersama kakaknya, Zaleha untuk mengelak daripada Orked tetapi anak-anaknya berjaya berjumpa Orked.

programme.title: MELUR UNTUK FIRDAUS 2
programme.desc: Melur and Firdaus are now happy and want to strengthen their relationship but begin to face many challenges. Adding on to this, Firdaus finds himself spending more time with his colleague, Mawar while working on a project together.

programme.title: BUDAK TEBING

programme.title: BLOGGER BOY
programme.desc: Nina berminat bekerjasama dengan Blogger Boy untuk pameran fotografinya yang pertama. Dia tidak sedar Blogger Boy adalah nama samaran Budi. Sementara itu, Budi telah dibelasah oleh teman lelaki Suria yang menyangka dia ialah Kid.

programme.title: JALAN-JALAN MAKAN ANGIN 2016
programme.desc: Episod ini hos Anas dan Nadzmi akan menjejaki penginapan unik di Malaysia, melakukan pelbagai aktiviti menarik dan menikmati juadah istimewa tempatan. Pengembaraan mereka bermula di sebuah hotel yang terletak KLIA 2.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Luke's vampire companions track him down...

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

programme.title: 3AM - The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: 3AM - The Office
programme.desc: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

programme.title: 3AM - The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: BAYANGAN LELAKI SEMPURNA
programme.desc: Ammar, seorang duda muda bekerja sebagai penjual ikan di pasar terpaksa bekerja keras untuk menyara anak perempuannya Aqish, yang masih tadika. Dia terpaksa buat 2 kerja untuk menyara kehidupan beliau dan anak kesayangannya.

programme.title: CINTA NON GRATA
programme.desc: Darlina khayal dan telah mengikuti seorang lelaki yang dia kenali di kelab itu. Lelaki itu cuba mengambil kesempatan terhadap Darlina. Hakim yang bimbang, pantas mencari Darlina. Mujurlah dia dapat mengesan di mana Darlina.

programme.title: KERANA CINTA ITU DUSTA
programme.desc: Orked mempertikaikan kepada Sufian tentang kehadiran Seri dalam majlis tersebut. Orked juga cuba mendapatkan kepastian daripada Seri tentang hubungannya dengan Sufian. Seri menafikan malah menceritakan permintaan Orked kepada Sufian.

programme.title: KAPSUL SURAH (2018)
programme.desc: Bacaan SURAH YAASIN serta terjemahannya.

programme.title: BACAAN AL-QURAN 2014
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al-Quran surah AR-Rahmman oleh Ustaz Ahmad Tirmizi Hj Ali.

programme.title: BACAAN YASIN 2025
programme.desc: Bacaan Surah Yasin

programme.title: CINTA NON GRATA
programme.desc: Darlina dirawat di hospital kerana kecederaan. Oleh kerana kecederaan tidak begitu teruk Datuk Marzuki kemudian menghantar Darlina ke rumah Malik, supaya Ramlah boleh menjaganya sementara dia masih trauma dan cedera.

programme.title: EJEN ALI SEASON 1

programme.title: NUR UNTUK ARIFF
programme.desc: Arif memecat Laila sebagai Pengurus Pemasaran serta menguruskan wang pampasan buatnya. Episod ini menyaksikan Laila dihantar ke hotel dan secara rasminya terputus segala hubungan dengan keluarga Arif bermula dari saat tersebut.

programme.title: 5 RENCAH 5 RASA 2024
programme.desc: Episod ini Cef Dato Fazley Yaakob menyediakan 5 jenis masakan bertemakan "Kunyit" dan cara menyediakan pencuci mulut iaitu Aiskrim Malaysia Kunyit Nanas dan Pudina dan teh Tarik Madu Kunyit.

programme.title: MELASTIK KE HATIMU
programme.desc: Ziyyad, pengurus kilang tempat Haura bekerja. Ziyyad digelar ‘kayu cengal’ oleh pekerja-pekerja kerana Ziyyad sangat tegas dan serius. Susah nak tengok Ziyyad senyum apatah lagi bergurau dengan pekerja-pekerjanya.

programme.title: RISIK PADA HATI
programme.desc: Aisyah mengambil keputusan meninggalkan Adam dan Omar. Hayfa merasa menyesal kerana mendengar tomahan Suhara sehingga menyebabkan perpisahan Aisyah dengan anaknya Omar. Hayfa merasa berdosa dengan tindakannya.

programme.title: JAADU TERI NAZAR – DAAYAN KA MAUSAM
programme.desc: Gauri takut dan tekad melarikan diri setelah dapat tahu Vihaan adalah raja kumpulan wanita sihir. Belum sempat meninggalkan rumah, Gauri diancam wanita sihir. Vihaan muncul menyelamatkan Gauri. Rekha menyerahkan Charu kepada kumpulan samseng.

programme.title: AKU BUKAN USTAZAH 2
programme.desc: Aminah memaklumkan kepada Lembaga Pengarah Madrasah bahawa Omar akan mengambil alih tempat Sam sebagai Pengurus di Madrasah An-Nuur dan ini membuatkan Sam terkejut, kecewa, dan marah dengan keputusan Aminah itu.

programme.title: BAYANGAN LELAKI SEMPURNA
programme.desc: Julia dimasukkan ke hospital setelah cedera akibat jatuh dari tangga. Eva berjaya membersihkan nama sebagai suspek menolak Julia. Selain itu Eva cuba mempengaruh Julia untuk bekerjasama dengannya untuk mengaut harta syarikat.

programme.title: ISTERI MISTERI
